for: capability_tests/sfx_library.py — the answer key of the retrieval probes (semantic, precision, recall_lib, by_example)
id_form: <category>/<filename>, exactly the key of the sidecar record — e.g. sfx/waves_hull_01.wav
note: Twenty text queries written against what the house libraries actually hold on 2026-09-30 (95 sfx beds, 1049 344-Audio foley, 1684 344-Audio human mouth noises, 2 derived soundtracks, 6 merges). The queries are FIXED and a runner may not reword them. `accept` and `relevant` are EMPTY on purpose: no one has listened yet, and we do not grade a search against an answer we have not checked ourselves.
how_to_verify: For each query the operator opens the SFX Library tab, plays candidates with the ranking hidden, and writes into `accept` every slate id that is a usable first hit for that query (normally 1-3), and into `relevant` every slate id that belongs in a top-ten for it (normally 3-15). `by_example` is filled the same way: ten slate ids the operator can confirm are single, unambiguous recordings. When every query has a non-empty `accept` and a non-empty `relevant`, set `verified` to true. Until then semantic, precision, recall_lib and by_example ship `untested — key unverified`.

queries.query: a heavy wooden door creaking open
footsteps on wooden boards
water surging against a ship's hull
seagulls calling over a harbour
hemp rope and rigging creaking under load
a canvas sail flapping in wind
a sword striking a shield
a spear thrusting into flesh
a man coughing and clearing his throat
a woman groaning in pain
a sharp intake of breath
a crowd of people screaming in agony
coins poured onto a wooden table
a church bell struck once
rain falling on a roof
thunder rolling in the distance
horse hooves on cobbles
a fire crackling in a hearth
a quill pen scratching on paper
an earthenware jug smashing on stone

by_example_note: Ten slate ids, filled by the operator, each an unambiguous single recording. The by_example probe queries the library WITH that file's audio and requires the file's own id back at rank 1.
near_dupe_note: One query, its top ten read as a set: the question is whether the ten are ten performances or one file filed ten times.
tag_vocab_note: The controlled list is the sidecar's OWN declared fields as they exist on 2026-09-30 (asset_library_service.py writes them); `tags` measures the share of tag values that sit in a field of this list rather than in free text inside `notes`.
